core_aesthetic_takeaways: This batch is valuable for environmental-art competition boards that need clear sequence and diagram logic.
The strongest transferable structure is the five-board chain: concept, location, logic, mechanism, rendering.
Orange is used effectively as an annotation system rather than decoration.
The mechanism illustration board is especially useful for teaching arrows, component diagrams, and motion logic.
The batch helps avoid clutter by separating map analysis, text reasoning, and rendering views into distinct board types.
prompt_structure_lessons: Start prompts by naming the board type before adding content.
Separate project title, section heading, main figure, annotations, and explanatory text band.
Use orange only for functional markers, arrows, site highlights, and accent blocks.
For location boards, describe map hierarchy and callout placement without inventing exact coordinates.
For mechanism boards, describe arrow purpose and component relations rather than adding arbitrary arrows.

text_accuracy_policy.training_rule: Use the batch for board hierarchy and diagram logic. Do not train dense Chinese paragraphs or map text as exact copy without source text.

risk_controls.mitigation: Keep long paragraphs as placeholder layout unless exact source text is provided.
Use map boards for grayscale hierarchy and orange site highlights, not exact GIS labels or coordinates.
Require each arrow to describe motion direction, rotation, or transmission relation.
Preserve view_type separation between concept render, map, logic, mechanism, and final rendering boards.
Treat human figures as scale references only, not required style assets.

recommended_training_use.stage_1_curation: include as an environmental-art and exhibition-board positive case after rights review
recommended_training_use.stage_2_caption_tuning: use captions to teach board sequencing, map analysis, diagram logic, and orange annotation discipline
recommended_training_use.stage_3_lora_training: train as an environmental-competition board subset before mixing with brand VI or packaging cases

negative_prompt_atoms: mixed concept map logic render on one uncontrolled page
